title: ArcCivs bounded adjacent lava clearance restores one existing native cut
assumptions: Low/base/high intentionally describe the same single captured Auto2 blockage and one subsequent real STONE receipt; one miner/quarry is included. This is a finite correctness assessment, not telemetry or a daily farm rate.

Before: the captured source is inaccessible to the old source-only focus; zero accepted physical cut for this blockage. After: one observed 2000ms securing-mine action removes exactly one LAVA cell immediately adjacent to the exact reachable unchanged rock face, outputs zero, costs zero items and gives zero excavation progress.

The following real 2000ms STONE cut retains its existing native one-COBBLESTONE drop and one existing tool use, resident slots and ordinary delivery. It advances only the actual one cut; the same sealed inventory journal prevents duplicate world/item credit after restart. Other stone/ore drop rules, Fortune/Silk Touch and generator rates are unchanged.

The two physical sessions are sequential: at least4000ms plus real native travel, bounded discovery, meals, supplies and storage. Ordinary native excavation remains at most1800 nominal two-second actions/hour before those costs; no new rate or quantity is added. The existing six-second 95/4/1 Auto fallback stays an alternative session and is not added to this finite native receipt.
No direct Vault, tokens or player XP payout exists for either receipt. Resident profession training is distinct from player XP. No money price or item-to-money exchange rate is assumed.

Current EconomyShopGUI SELL/AutoSell remains a separate existing downstream flow; the planned SELL-to-contract transition remains separate and no future contract income is assumed. Arbitrage/resale value is unknown without current verified prices, not zero.

All owner/Lands, loaded chunks, city/building bounds, immutable native preimages, cover, safe standing and reach to the exact frontier remain required. Source is exactly one adjacent planned cell; no remote clearance through additional walls or unpaid native path is authorized.

No new price, progression cost, currency multiplier or global item budget is introduced. Many cities can each resolve their own finite blockage once; the historical completed-generator rate and Auto fallback ceiling remain separately assessed in mine-auto-fallback-economy-assessment.json.

flows.basis: One finite captured blockage: zero reward for lava, then one existing native STONE drop. This is a bounded one-receipt comparison, not a recurring daily production estimate.
